title: I'm not sure what I'm doing anymore - another side of life in the forest
en: You don't like it. Without a doubt, the main

reason my anxiety has become so difficult to control lately is simply the sheer amount of change in general. And I think anyone who has an anxiety disorder or just understands what it's like to live with those feelings knows that change in general, whether good or bad, can be very difficult when you're an xious person by nature. I was anxious person by nature. I was very worried about the release of my book. I have never published my texts in this form before. This is definitely the fulfillment of a dream I've had since early childhood. And now that this is happening, I'm imagining all sorts of scary scenarios in my head about how

this will all end. A lot of it doesn't make sense, and it was quite scary at times. I think it's because of all these factors , the expectation of change, such a huge change in my life, and also the death of my rabbit, one of my best friends. I experienced very severe panic attacks that I had never had before. They don't have a specific trigger. They seem to happen just from general stress, and I feel like I

can't breathe. I'm sure my throat was tightening, it was a horrible feeling, and it was very difficult. Luke was so wonderful and supportive of me throughout this entire process. He knew, and I knew, that it would be a difficult transition—changing lifestyle and place of residence. And I am very grateful to him for that. Such anxious periods in my life are quite natural for me. I'll leave a link to a book I read once, there's a lot of research on people like me, and it was incredibly helpful to understand that anxiety isn't necessarily a sign of fragility, it doesn't make you a weaker

or broken person. Anxiety at its best is the feeling that you don't care. That you don't care what happens to you. You don't care what happens to others. You care about the planet. And I like that at the heart of these feelings is a desire to help, a desire to care, rather than a desire to despair and turn away from the problems we face, as individuals or as a society. Anxiety makes me a better person. She makes me compassionate. She makes me empathize to a degree that is overwhelming at times . I truly believe that people

who feel things so deeply can see it as both a gift and a challenge that must be learned to cope with in a healthy way. But I really think that feeling these emotions can be helpful for others. I think you should just learn to manage them in a way that doesn't cause harm. Recently, panic attacks have become quite debilitating for me and are greatly affecting my sleep. But yes, lately it has been a time of happiness, joy, but also stress and anxiety. Believe it or not, these feelings can coexist. I'm returning to peace of mind by doing what I love and focusing on the bright moments, because that's what

this channel is for. This is what you've seen in my videos the last few months— focusing on the positive. To remember what I am grateful for, all the beautiful things in my life, to celebrate the beauty of this area in the spring, and all the things that bring me joy. Reading has been a huge benefit lately. I read more than ever . I read, read and read. It has always been a wonderful and healthy way to escape reality, helping me to recover and return to the world a better person, feeling more at peace. As you can see, this week's video is

a little different from the others. I simply wasn't able to create my usual content. I know I'll be back to it soon, but I wanted to dedicate this week to connecting with the people I love, and of course that includes my husband, Luke, who has been an incredible support to me as I adjust to my new life. I'm not sure how much you enjoy listening to me talk to the camera. Sometimes it helps me to talk to the camera to feel a connection with you, but I also understand that it's not to everyone's liking. I know it's impossible to create something that everyone will like . I really appreciate you being here, and I know I'll get even more comfortable in the coming weeks. And
so, you can probably see that I did n't have a clear plan this week, but I'm still grateful to you and I hope you have a wonderful week. I send you my love. See you later.
zh: 你不喜欢它。毫无疑问，主要
我的焦虑最近变得如此难以控制的原因仅仅是总体上的巨大变化。我认为任何患有焦虑症或只是了解与这些感觉一起生活的人都知道，当你本质上是一个焦虑的人时，无论好坏，一般的改变都可能非常困难。我本质上是一个焦虑的人。我非常担心我的书的发行。我以前从未以这种形式发表过我的文章。这绝对是我从小就有的一个梦想的实现。现在这一切都发生了，我在脑海中想象着各种可怕的场景
这一切都会结束。很多事情没有意义，有时还很可怕。我想这是因为所有这些因素，对改变的期望，我生活中如此巨大的改变，以及我最好的朋友之一兔子的去世。我经历了以前从未有过的非常严重的恐慌发作。他们没有特定的触发因素。它们似乎只是由于一般压力而发生，我觉得我
无法呼吸。我确信我的喉咙发紧，这是一种可怕的感觉，而且非常困难。卢克在整个过程中都非常出色并且支持我。他知道，我也知道，这将是一个艰难的转变——改变生活方式和居住地。我对此非常感谢他。生活中出现这种焦虑的时期对我来说是很自然的。我会留下我读过的一本书的链接，有很多像我这样的人的研究，了解焦虑不一定是脆弱的标志，它不会让你变得更弱，这是非常有帮助的
或破碎的人。最好的焦虑是一种你不在乎的感觉。你不在乎发生在你身上的事情。你不在乎别人发生什么。你关心这个星球。我喜欢这些感觉的核心是渴望帮助、渴望关心，而不是渴望绝望并回避我们作为个人或社会所面临的问题。焦虑让我成为一个更好的人。她让我富有同情心。她有时让我产生难以抗拒的同情心。我确实相信人们

对事物有如此深刻感受的人可以将其视为一种礼物，也是一种必须学会以健康的方式应对的挑战。但我真的认为感受这些情绪对其他人是有帮助的。我认为你应该学会以一种不会造成伤害的方式来管理它们。最近，惊恐发作使我变得非常虚弱，并极大地影响了我的睡眠。但是，是的，最近这是一段幸福、快乐的时光，但也有压力和焦虑。不管你相信与否，这些感觉可以共存。通过做我喜欢的事情并专注于美好的时刻，我正在回归内心的平静，因为那就是
这个频道是为了.这就是你在过去几个月我的视频中看到的——关注积极的一面。记住我所感激的事情，我生命中所有美丽的事物，庆祝这个地区春天的美丽，以及所有给我带来欢乐的事物。最近读书受益匪浅。我读的书比以往任何时候都多。我读、读、读。它一直是逃避现实的一种美妙而健康的方式，帮助我康复并以一个更好的人的身份回到世界，感觉更加平静。如您所见，本周的视频是
与其他人有点不同。我根本无法创建我通常的内容。我知道我很快就会回来，但我想在本周专门与我爱的人联系，当然包括我的丈夫卢克，在我适应新生活的过程中，他给了我难以置信的支持。我不确定你有多喜欢听我对着镜头说话。有时对着镜头说话可以帮助我感受到与你的联系，但我也明白这并不是每个人都喜欢的。我知道不可能创造出所有人都会喜欢的东西。我真的很感谢你来到这里，我知道在接下来的几周里我会变得更加自在。和
所以，你大概可以看出我这周没有明确的计划，但我仍然很感激你，希望你度过愉快的一周。我送你我的爱。稍后见。
